playstyle: Tricky and evasive stance mix-ups. Phoenix (AOP) shrinks her hurtbox so she slips under highs and some mids (Wavu), back-turned (BT) and Hypnotist (HYP) add more mix-ups, and she wins by making the opponent whiff and launching them. She is tiny with short range, so long-limbed characters can wall her out: play compact and close the gap carefully.

stances.name: Art of Phoenix
stances.note: Her low-profile stance that ducks under highs and some mids.

stances.name: Back-turned
stances.entry: b+3, b+1 on hit and other moves
stances.note: BT.1,2 tornadoes and is a combo staple.

stances.name: Hypnotist
stances.note: A spinning stance; HYP.3+4 and HYP.2 end her combos. In Heat it skips its first step (Wavu).
